explication: diff-so-fancy is a command-line diff formatter used in Git paging/filter workflows or on unified diff input. It turns diff text into human-readable output, with configurable headers, line markers, rulers, and optional sem summaries. The README establishes the CLI’s relationship to its relative `lib/` directory, but the source excerpts do not show internal calls, so internal processing links are omitted. The optional sem integration is documented but its implementation is not sampled.
